_comment: SFX generation manifest for ElevenLabs Sound Effects API (eleven_text_to_sound_v2).
_sonic_identity: The world breathes softly; magic screams. Fayde is an android child fighting robots in a quiet underground world using elemental Prana abilities. All-ages (7+), pixel art, sci-fi dungeon crawler. Prana casts/hits/death are loud, sharp, elemental; movement/feedback are subtle.
_delivery_target: -18 LUFS integrated, -1 dBTP true peak. Transient SFX measured at dBTP; Prana cast/hit floor -6 dBTP. (Post-process normalization applied after generation if available.)

events.prompt: Bright sci-fi elemental magic cast release, sharp crackling energy whoosh with a clean punchy attack, short and snappy, video game spell.
